graphics: 20th Century Fox logo, the newspaper and Krusty TV intro, the loading screen, the tutorial box and Homer and Marge on the street with the HUD and radar render correctly, 60 fps in game.
notes: Tutorial box at about 90 s, then Homer on the street from about 110 s until the run stopped at 117 s, with sound.

graphics: Only the TDK Mediactive logo (10 s) renders; black from then on.
notes: The core stops at about 19 s with an unhandled access violation at 000ba334 (writing 00000000), right after a 12 KiB contiguous memory allocation failed; black and silent for the rest of the run.

graphics: City intro and the taxi driving through the streets with timer, speed and damage HUD render correctly, 56-60 fps.
notes: Driving from about 30 s (timer 43, then 31 and 26) until the run stopped at 57 s, with sound.

graphics: Fox Interactive logo, then the Radical Entertainment logo frozen from about 15 s to the end.
notes: Hangs on the Radical logo: the core's hang report starts at frame 855 with the guest CPU 99% in JIT compiling and rendering idle, for the rest of the run. The audio recording is empty; after quit the process didn't exit and was killed at 310.6 s.

graphics: Intro, the Loading screen and the rat-chase level with the tutorial banner, map, 'Rats Left 30' and timer render correctly, but only 7-31 fps.
notes: In game from about 50 s until the run stopped at 80 s; the game stalls again and again for 2-4.6 s (the core's hang report shows the guest CPU busy in JIT compiling), so the displayed rate swings between 7 and 31 fps. The audio recording is empty, so sound can't be judged; on quit the process didn't exit and was killed at 90 s.

graphics: The Sims logo and the Create a Sim name keyboard ('PAT') render correctly; black after the crash.
notes: The core stops at about 41 s on the Create a Sim name screen with an unhandled access violation at 0013e596 (writing 00607992); black and silent for the rest of the run.

graphics: Activision logo, difficulty select, the Prague mission briefing, a cutscene and the alley with crosshair and weapon HUD render correctly, 57-60 fps.
notes: Mission Info ('B Resume') from 45 s until the B at 73 s; after the cutscene, in the Prague alley from about 110 s until the run stopped at 135 s, with sound.

graphics: The Sniper Elite copyright screen, frozen from the first seconds to the end.

graphics: Nothing: black for the whole run.
notes: The core can't start the game: 'xbe: parse failed (-3)' then 'core: boot failed' right after reading the disc, and RetroArch runs without content for the rest of the run.
